The story must be exactly six sentences long. During the story, reveal that the chaos of that single walk gets caught on a neighbor's doorbell camera and goes mildly viral in the local group chat. Include the exact phrase "five leashes, zero plan" somewhere in the text. End with three new clients messaging him the very next day because of the video.
